name: Mitani Ayumu
source: Rikuto’s new little "brother" and a freshman at Asaoka High School. Ayumu has to hide from Rikuto that she's actually a girl because of her mom’s orders. Rikuto falls in love with her when she congratulates him for passing the exam at Asaoka High School.
